data.long_meaning: प्रमोद: The name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘pramod’ which means ‘to please’ or ‘to move’ and ‘anode’ which means ‘god’. This name signifies the god of creative energy and is often used to describe someone who is dynamic and full of life. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as ‘प्रमोद’ due to his ability to move and inspire.
